Holding cell (premises warrant does not authorize searching persons merely present; search or frisk needs particularized cause) matches pin-91 Rule ('A premises warrant does not reach the persons of those merely present; cause must be individualized') and star-verified pin-91a.
Summers lake record is 'verified', cluster_id 110534, official cite '452 U.S. 692', year 1981; absolute_url '/opinion/110534/michigan-v-summers/' matches the table opinion link.

Holding cell (premises warrant on PC carries limited authority to detain occupants while search conducted) matches pin-705 Issue/Rule ('Whether officers executing a warrant to search premises... may detain the occupants... Rule Yes').
Muehler lake record is 'verified', cluster_id 142878, official cite '544 U.S. 93', year 2005; absolute_url '/opinion/142878/muehler-v-mena/' matches the table opinion link.

Holding cell (detention authority categorical; handcuffs for duration where justified; non-prolonging questions need no separate suspicion) matches pin-98 Rule and star-verified pin-101 ('the officers did not need reasonable suspicion to ask Mena for her name, date and place of birth, or immigration status').

Core proposition (premises warrant carries limited authority to detain occupants, not search them) is supported: Summers pin-705 Rule = Yes (detain occupants during search); Ybarra pin-91/pin-91a supports 'not to search them / particularized cause'.

'Categorical (needs no individualized suspicion)' attributed to Muehler is supported by Muehler pin-98 ('The detention authority is categorical, and incidental questioning needs no separate justification').

'Spatially limited to the immediate vicinity' attributed to Bailey is supported by star-verified Bailey pin-199 and the Summers scope_note ('Spatial limit set by Bailey... immediate vicinity of the premises').

'Particularized to that person' at Ybarra 91 is corroborated by star-verified Ybarra pin-91a ('a search or seizure of a person must be supported by probable cause particularized with respect to that person').
residual_risks: The verbatim Summers-705 quotation ('A warrant to search for contraband founded on probable cause implicitly carries with it the limited authority to detain the occupants of the premises while a proper search is conducted') is not independently confirmable from disclosed evidence: pin-705 is slip-only (quote_fidelity mismatch), so exact wording is a quote_fidelity residual, though the substance is supported.
Callout anchors the spatial limit to Bailey#^pin-201, whose lake pinpoint is slip-only; the immediate-vicinity substance is nonetheless carried by star-verified pin-199.
